reviews.title: Sloppy
reviews.text: Signed up for free trial to see if I like the app but the issue with that is “tokens” to try filters so it’s not a free trial. I don’t mind paying for the year subscription when I know I like the application, but it’s difficult to explore and see if it fits my needs if I have to buy tokens to try a filter. However, I did pay 50 tokens and tried one filter it literally looked like somebody stuck a new face on top of the original photo and the color of the face didn’t match the rest of the neck and décolletage when I attempted to try a different filter it prompted another 100 tokens I’m not playing with tokens like a five year old just to see if I like the app. Canceled the free trial and movemoving on.

reviews.title: It was so good what happened??
reviews.text: I paid for a year then everything changed. Now you need “credits” to use the ai filters and only get 40 credits a year. Which got used up super fast just by checking what 1 image looks like suddenly you just used up a ton. I’m really disappointed. It was such a good app in the beginning 😣

reviews.title: Was great - now useless with the new updates.
reviews.text: It was a great app, but they recently removed the option to reduce the intensity of their AI filters, which now is an all-or-nothing edit. Most of the time, full intensity completely changes the facial features or it’s simply too much. It was amazing m when you can increase or decrease the filters. It gave a professional, studio-like edit. But now, you’re stuck with whatever the filter outputs. To add, now the AI edits require “tokens” which would essentially cost more money over time of usage. Unfortunate and I foresee the app continuing to go downhill unless they go back to the way it was. The other filters are fine, but nothing special that you can’t get on other apps.

reviews.title: could be good
reviews.text: I like the look of the filters they have but it is simply too expensive and almost nothing is available for free. On top of that, it is incapable of downloading your pictures from icloud within the app like almost every other photo editor i’ve ever used. If i want to use a photo which is stored in iCloud(almost everything in my camera roll as a photo hoarder), i have to go to my camera roll and wait for it to download before it can be used. I’ll stick with snow 🤷‍♀️ much better value even if it lacks some of the admittedly innovative features this app has

reviews.title: Deceptive pricing! Beware! Zero stars. Cancelled subscription. Other apps are much better.
reviews.text: Update: I emailed the developer and they gave zero resolution to the problem and I cancelled my subscription. There are many more apps that do a much better job without this outrageous deceptive pricing. Such as, BgMaster, Colorize, ReShoot, Yore, AI Photo. Stay away from this app. They said they needed a mental health day and now they’re back..,that’s because everyone is furious they got ripped off and they’re posting terrible reviews about this app. I purchased a one year subscription on June 12, 2026 and was able to use all features including the AI camera features with zero restrictions and zero up charges. Now all of a sudden I cannot use any AI camera features and the app is telling me I am out of “credits”. Under no circumstances were credits ever required or when I made my subscription purchase, nor was it indicated that credits would be an additional required purchase at a later date. I will be canceling my subscription and writing a review telling people this app has deceptive pricing.

reviews.title: Total Scam
reviews.text: I purchased the annual subscription about a month ago and absolutely loved this app… Until they changed their model where you have to use credits every single time you use an AI feature. There’s literally nothing about this app worth using any longer, as you’ll end up using all your credits just trying to find a filter you like per photo. I honestly wish I could get my money back because it was a total scam

reviews.title: Not happy with updates
reviews.text: At first, I loved this app. I paid for premium and used it to filter all my pics and make them look cuter. I used the blue hour filter on soooo many pictures of sunsets and views and it made me glad I spent my money on better filters. Then I open my app last week to edit a photo and I find out that I have to spend MORE money in order to get the experience that I had ALREADY PAID FOR. So disappointed in this recent update and I am very unhappy that I spent money in the first place. Really unfortunate because it was such a good app at first.
